description: APPROVED floor-plan / site-map sources. scripts/nhs/fetch-plans.mjs downloads exactly what is listed here and nothing else. Entries arrive from data/plan-candidates.json (produced by scripts/nhs/discover-plans.mjs) only after a human has confirmed the PDF is the right map and that reuse is acceptable — these are the trusts' copyright, not open data. sha256 is filled in on the first fetch and checked on every later run, so a republished map surfaces as an explicit change instead of silently regenerating every waypoint.
